items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He just loves to write down the history of this part of California. ... Iola would have his name. ... my other [ ] on my mother’s side, who was Henry Ivy. Owned a livery stable in Concord.

ctx.x: 1896, around in there. But there is a man that has written up all this who lives in Litchfield, which is a town nearby. Iola would have his name. He just loves to write down the history of this part of California. It’s a pretty wild history. So my dad came to Concord with a couple of carloads of animals, landed at the railroad station, and unloaded the two cars. He needed some cowboys to help him drive the cattle from Concord out to the new ranch. So he went to my other [ ] on my mother’s side, who was Henry Ivy.…
Were your grandparents alive when you were a young boy? Did you have many recollections of them?
